summary: DROP CANDIDATE (permit-only camping): the page's area rule reads 'Camping allowed by special use permit only ... Camping is prohibited' (brochure the same), though Things to Do lists 'Designated Camping Sites' and the map (02/24) marks one Camping symbol at a small gravel pull-off on Bluffton Rd = GIS 1054. Fees/hookups written manual; booking written as permit-only (fcfs never) in case it stays. Pin on that pull-off. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (camping by special use permit only, no walk-up or reservable camping): area page, 3CSR 10-11 Rule 140 Camping: 'Camping allowed by special use permit only. Visit MDC.mo.gov for more information. Camping is prohibited.'; the page also says 'Special use permits should be requested at least 30 days in advance' and 'Application for a special use permit does not guarantee that one will be issued.' Brochure (2023-05): 'Camping allowed by special use permit only. Please visit our public website for more information.' Against that, 'Things to Do When You Visit' lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites', the map (02/24) shows one Camping symbol at the north parking lot on Bluffton Rd, and GIS 27 has a 'Designated Camping Area' point (1054) there. Imagery: the lot (1297) is a gravel pull-off ~15 x 10 m on the east shoulder of the gravel Bluffton Rd, room for one rig. A permit requested a month ahead and not guaranteed is not public camping; criteria call is AWH's.
BOOKING: written as reservable false / fcfs never with the permit note, so a kept entry doesn't advertise walk-up camping. No 14-day limit written: the area's own Rule 140 replaces the standard text.
PIN: stored 38.71419,-91.62039 = GIS 1054, 11 m from lot 1297 on Bluffton Rd; fine.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the Missouri River is ~1 km south beyond Highway 94 and the bottomland; Sinthianna Creek is a small stream west of the road.
Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text, the 14-day limit, 'MDC-designated drive-in sites', 'site length not published' and directions dropped; permit-only camping and the pull-off put in.
